title: MSI vs Portable
author: bruste77
body_snippet: Mremote folder structure is different comparing msi installation with portable. See the comparison Due to this also the look&feel is affected Mremote installed with msi Mremote portable

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks for the clear side-by-side, @bruste77 — the folder-layout difference between the MSI and the portable build is exactly the kind of thing that breaks theme loading (mRemoteNG looks for the `Themes` subfolder relative to the executable).

To pin down which installer is at fault, could you confirm:

1. Which build the MSI came from — the nightly (`nightly` release tag) or a tagged release — and the exact version string from **Help → About**.
2. After you "aligned the folders manually", where...

comments.author: bruste77
comments.snippet: Msi version is mRemoteNG-nightly-20260612-v1.82.0-beta.3-0ff3a88-x64 To make themes visible in configuration I've to put themes folder in C:\Program Files\mRemoteNG, but after doing that config section color looks weird Also the font in the config section looks less defined compared to the origal mremote 1.78.2

notes: theme-folder fallback (9e81169af) postdates reporter beta.3 0ff3a88; MSI not shipping Themes folder = packaging; PropertyGrid color/font separate; retest portable next nightly
